nc.description: A low-poly 3D model of a white cylinder with a grey top handle and segmented grey rings is displayed against a white background.
A grey, 3D-rendered mechanical linkage connects a single shaft to two parallel arms featuring rectangular blocks.
A mechanical joint connects a forked arm to a base block via a cylindrical pin, with thick wire coiled around the arm and looped onto the base.
A 3D rendering shows an exploded view of a mechanical assembly featuring a grey faceted shaft, white contoured connectors, a metallic ring, and a flanged base.
A central white rectangular mechanism containing gears is surrounded by concentric rings of white geometric blocks and metallic connecting rods.

vc.description: A mechanical gripper is holding a translucent cylindrical object.
A monochromatic 3D rendering displays a mechanical assembly featuring interconnected gears, a track, a coiled spring, and a lever connected to a threaded rod.
A grey mechanical model displays two coiled springs attached to a system of interlocking gears and a connecting arm, all resting on a base plate with four stepped feet.
Separated grey mechanical components are shown alongside a smaller, broken cylindrical piece.
A white mechanical device with exposed gears is surrounded by a circular arrangement of plastic handles, molded parts on sprues, and piles of plastic pellets.
